notes.title: New environments and cyborgs for Cyborg Arena 2 !
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33866305/4dced07752bfec53a8c5fbb0a79b1b677dc6e639.png[/img]
A large update has been released for [b]Cyborg Arena 2[/b], formerly known as Cyborg Arena UE4, the sequel of Cyborg Arena !

It includes the release of [b]many new missions set in new environments[/b]  and [b]more variety of cyborgs to fight!
[/b]

4 kind of cyborgs are now present in the game to fight ! The [b]Mega Cyborg[/b], [b]Strong Cyborg[/b], [b]Medium Cyborg[/b] and [b]Zombie Cyborg[/b] !

Among the missions which were available in the first release (Cyborg Wasteland and Forest), [b]4 new environments were added ![/b]

[h1]DESERT[/h1]
A semi arid desert with canyons and abandoned wooden shacks surrounded by cyborgs fortifications all along the path which goes to the only motorway!

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33866305/589e17766f6b7fd7ace44ed5e5f955c9e0161597.jpg[/img]
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33866305/69008ac70e949e531a779f90bfe46202152e94c1.jpg[/img]
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33866305/ae7897111cf1db2a953964b21e52f843385b4689.jpg[/img]

[h1]SLUMS[/h1]
A tropical small village made of makeshift materials with cyborg fortifications all around to destroy.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33866305/b9ce1684d576ad86b5eaf6ca96ae1798272f26b5.jpg[/img]
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33866305/fbff4f44e4f45ff9cb03c87579ccb526b95ce6a3.jpg[/img]

[h1]ABANDONED TOWN[/h1]
A small abandoned town covered with vegetation and surrounded by a dense forest populated of cyborgs and cyborg antennas.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33866305/e936fcc6945b81a7fa0976ede5360d981bb71511.jpg[/img]
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33866305/7e5354feb734fd26389bbdc5fd130d0e7fb76266.jpg[/img]

[h1]DESERT TOWN[/h1]
A small town consisting of gas station, a motel and caravans on an arid desert connected with roads coming from various sides with cyborgs camps all around.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33866305/6fc4e173ee2f425dd350a4be5b6b0a460fe21333.jpg[/img]
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33866305/25326b4d365a0c646dc873f85e84ba3bb6694328.jpg[/img]

[h1]FOREST[/h1]
A large country side place made of forest and plains with occasional farms and cyborgs installations hidden all around.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33866305/a8244c5118478e5aef4af3bde90c21c26ecbce7c.jpg[/img]
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33866305/90bae04e1eb1c097f45b730d56b40be8ab9a5877.jpg[/img]

[h1]CYBORG WASTELAND[/h1]
A vast mountain desert with series of cyborgs fortified lines and antennas to assault and destroy!

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33866305/43943f399c88a4400bcf8d74dfc0ac1b1a76a8d2.jpg[/img]
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33866305/3f9bc0fa7d882f6cc8b119ecea0055619462b3ae.jpg[/img]

A new trailer has been released to showcase the new content !
https://youtu.be/f52YWzFHO-4

This content has been added to the current release and is now available!

I hope you enjoyed this news!
Devdan

notes.title: Huge update for Zombie Road Rider! New maps and new zombies!
notes.content:
Hi people!

[b]Zombie Road Rider[/b] has received a [b]huge update[/b] that was on the work for some times now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1175640/Zombie_Road_Rider/

Actually, the game has received a series of updates since the last news that was posted last year ago! So what is new?

A full new environment to play! The [b]City Downtown[/b] ! Set in an environment made of skyscrapers and large roads, save the survivors who are running around and bring them to the safe house!

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33866305/95a0d1b7264481b6ac5e137bf3a7d2fe666b76aa.jpg[/img]

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33866305/8f4e97a8c6bfae9a50ea725db8a7de4d3c9d0064.jpg[/img]

Another new environment, the [b]Industrial Town[/b]! Set in narrow streets with old industrial style buildings, largely populated with fully physics-based props, obstacles and zombies to road ride!

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33866305/98f1e6fe837711a742a3775547dfccf23bc79310.jpg[/img]

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33866305/fee8a8ddef73791dcacdc55f7d52fc7fca266e03.jpg[/img]

[b]The Factory[/b], a modern industrial type place with barricades and zombies to destroy!

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33866305/ade6a5df7052809be50173755ebab3f195d6ac41.jpg[/img]

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33866305/a7e51c4dc1321136d3d203c7e5a49f4ee1aa8802.jpg[/img]

Another one main new aspect of the game is that [b]+30 zombies were added [/b]to replace the old classic one, so that the game has more variety of characters!

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33866305/d026c4dfa1436d565e546f9a344a423bbf313c46.jpg[/img]

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33866305/79c36fe1d10ef8ab1a5221af2a1626267cdd9578.jpg[/img]

[b]Physics of the cars and vehicles were reworked[/b] to feel more enjoyable and powerful against the obstacles and zombies on the road. Improvements were made on the graphics and the optimisation of the game to have it run more smoothly. The menu and user interface was also reworked to be more intuitive and easier to use.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0qe6t-gvPVg

The environments that were added have support for both rescue and freeride game mode!

So this pretty sum up all what you will find in this large update! I hope you will enjoy!

Best,
Devdan

notes.title: Major update for Cyborg Arena
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33866305/0544346ef1acf52ae895e61bed0dc0ec49a9642a.jpg[/img]

Following the upcoming release of Cyborg Arena UE4, the sequel of [b]Cyborg Arena[/b] made with Unreal Engine 4.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1258730/Cyborg_Arena_UE4/?beta=0

A major update has been done to the game !

In an attempt to improve the gameplay, graphics and all other parts of the game since its release in 2017, a major update has been released to the game.

You can find the change log here.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33866305/53faebfb6ff92ecbf7e904c2fbef54420efe4473.jpg[/img]

[h1]MARCH 2020 UPDATE FOR CYBORG ARENA[/h1]
[list]
[*] Major redesign of the adventure map.
[*] Redesigning of the menu.
[*] Removed some intro cinematic in the adventure map.
[*] Changed the buggy with a protected armored car.
[*] Changed roads and access through the mountains.
[*] Added firing effects with cyborgs firing fast projectiles which can be seen and dodged instead of classic and hard to cover instant hits.
[*] Improved collision detection system from cyborgs projectiles to be able to take cover from cyborgs fire.
[*] Redesigning of cyborgs defense lines and assault waves.
[*] Redesigning of the graphics to have a more brighter and clean lighting with maps set during day light instead of dark foggy night.
[*] Optimization for the landscapes and graphics.
[*] Changed and simplified the ambient music.
[*] Changed the classic med kit system to a health regenerating system.
[*] Redesigned the in-game HUD to improve immersion in the game. 
[*] Added more indications messages on the screen.
[*] Improved and relocated ammunition stocks on the adventure map with more visual indications to find them and in better strategic places.  
[*] Removed the sprint limit to be able to run faster without limit.
[*] Remade the scoring system to focus on cyborgs kills count.
[*] Remade the trailer and screenshots.
[*] Updated the store page with the changes.
[*] Added library graphics assets in Steamworks.
[*] Redesigned the game icon.
[*] Removed some BIK launching videos to make the game installation files lighter.
[*] Redesigned the arena mode to be able to complete it after clearing the arena from all cyborgs.
[*] Lowered the sound volume of weapons SFX which were too louder.
[*] Remade the ending of the game.
[*] Improved the driving of vehicle.
[*] Relocated the different vehicles spawn points with driveable and non driveable areas.
[*] Reworked the arena maps.
[*] Readjusted the kill all cyborgs achievement to sync with the new update.
[*] Fixed the sound issue when replenishing ammo.
[*] Ammo replenishment will now also automatically fulfill the ammo inside the weapon clip.
[/list]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33866305/b7e7879605227644ebb60f388b5810dbe3e0cc6b.jpg[/img]

The game will continue to receive additional update !

I hope you will like it now !

notes.title: Graphics and gameplay update for Cyborg Arena
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30573702/f487ff16ae82cda8bce71bb039455303044f86c7.jpg[/img]
About a year after its release, [b]the game has received an update[/b] improving the graphics, gameplay and the overall ambient through the game ! By using the feedback acquired since the Early Access.

The main change is the [b]game being made much more brighter[/b] with less darkness and post process lens, so it is easier to play and distinct the elements of the game.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30573702/fdbdb2b71f616c48d84c5d7e1435f7238bd13131.jpg[/img]

[b]Introduction cinematics[/b] were added to give a better ambient when starting the adventure map, with a deep and sharp-eyed ambient music to begin with.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30573702/847c905a34de336a92f9b2aeb82f70a9e8f9f99b.jpg[/img]

About the gameplay, [b]more buggys, medkits, barricades and ammo crates were added on the adventure map[/b] to avoid the frustration of missing them when fighting the cyborgs.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30573702/34702da76949c24a5cc655f4c4a9b692b7305ae7.jpg[/img]

Works were also done to [b]re-market the game[/b], with a brand [b]new trailer[/b], screenshots, icon and store page.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30573702/abfe9b962c8f74f67e879155895b434040821e34.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30573702/4e3ead18164383711648b0b3dc3b6d0867420002.jpg[/img]
https://youtu.be/ydKPPIrnovg
Some [b]minor changes[/b] were also done for subtitles and the menu which has now an in-game background, new loading screen

To sum up the works, here is the change list for this [b]update of 18 November 2018[/b] :[list]
[*] Added introduction cinematic.
[*] Improvements for the graphics with better brightness and lightness.
[*]  Improvements of the game with new musics, menu and interactive background.
[*]  Reduced darkness and post process of the lens/vignette.
[*]  Added multiples buggys on the adventure map.
[*]  Added more medkits.
[*]  Added more barricades on the adventure map.
[*]  Added more weapons, ammo crates and grenades crates.
[*]  Updated the Steam store page.
[*]  New game icon and graphics assets.
[*]  Remade the trailer.
[*]  Changed loading screen.
[*]  Changed in-game texts and subtitles.
[/list]

Work is still being done to have the game available on Mac OS, but the task is still in its infancy.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/706440/Cyborg_Arena/

Thanks for reading,
[i]Devdan[/i]
http://devdangames.com

notes.title: Full release of Cyborg Arena, with a complete video walkthrough !
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30573702/8c81314cd15e341b0461549a60989942d511ed0a.jpg[/img]

It is after almost 8 months of development that I am very glad to announce that Cyborg Arena has finally been launched as a full release !

It was after first being announced in Greenlight back in April, and Greenlit in June, that the game was released as an Early Access, in October. Since then, a lot of testing, improvements, bug fixes were done for the game to achieve this final build.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30573702/3ca0abede29ac12e7e1bc0a0e165a3e2b19f9606.jpg[/img]

During the development of the game, more content and features were developed than what was actually announced in the early trailer. From a simple arena-based game with only few arena maps and weapons from Action Alien, Cyborg Arena has turned into a complete single player game, with a large adventure map explorable with a buggy and 4 arena maps with pickable boost bonus.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30573702/f085b24a0aa85605be7ad6800ea14fe238261408.jpg[/img]

A lot of work was done for the cyborgs, especially in creating the different and distinctive animations used when they are walking, running and firing. A dynamic loadout system was also created, which gives to each cyborg a different set of headgears, armors, dresses and weapons randomly created at the beginning of each game.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30573702/c51130ce1cb219fd09563a0eb80ae0fca770ab51.jpg[/img][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30573702/eae9abe906cd126203a84f69498db341220d3c3c.jpg[/img][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30573702/43aaddb176cf06548e1a76d6f9fe21e51e721f79.jpg[/img][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30573702/95d82116a30d84939b335996fcee9c05657ffb78.jpg[/img][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30573702/f41fc27b5eda562b96df5ea97ba48f73c0113849.jpg[/img]

Work was also done on the cyborg bosses to make them appear much more imposing than the rest of the cyborgs. They wear a heavier armor, have glowing eyes and will be harder to defeat. In the adventure map, they are a also key element of the mission, by dropping the batteries required to power up the long range antenna and send the SOS signal.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30573702/11ebc5e64a8112272245b5f29ee84206cced3f25.jpg[/img][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30573702/40ac6f2175c1df67389dc63c1152bff6e57cd182.jpg[/img][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30573702/fb438d4901a9d11f9fc5fea5c5c8e23cd900741a.jpg[/img]

The buggy which is also a core element of the adventure map was added to give a more complete gameplay instead of simple combat sequences. It has allowed to create a larger adventure map with many paths and secret places to find. During some tests, having the buggy to pass a bump at high speed could make it fly around and land it on its roof. This is why a smart system was implemented which allows the player to bounce the buggy back to its wheels !

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30573702/af32acb37161ec2e65298628e9efc395ecd15289.jpg[/img]

In an attempt to create a credible storyline and improve the narrative dimension of the game, voice acting was done for the radio communications between the commander and the soldiers, depicting their retreats after being overrun by the cyborgs.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30573702/35b69e5da96805f88144677ac9cfdef9b02634a1.jpg[/img]

Last but not least, to make sure the game was ready for the full release, a complete walkthrough of the adventure map was recorded which last about one hour. It does not show the arena maps but you may watch it to simply have a preview of the game, or if you already have the game but are stuck somewhere in the adventure map.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=igaPt_HS7Zg
So with all these things done, the game should have a decent amount of content to leave Early Access. It will of course continue to be updated and improved in the future, but this time as an update for a full version !

Thanks for reading,
Devdan
[url]http://devdangames.com[/url]

notes.title: New arena map Scrapyard Night for Cyborg Arena
notes.content:
One more arena map has been added to the game, named [b]Scrapyard Night[/b] and which is taking place at night, inside a small scrapyard surrounded with walls of metal sheets.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30573702/6ee3c9d4e88dd4613cfae690925f3156d69c795e.jpg[/img]

The stacks of metal scrap provide an efficient cover against the cyborgs and the terrain itself has many high slopes giving a lot of spots to jump when cyborgs are firing.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30573702/107bda6392cbdec278dc64106ef225956b30ae4e.jpg[/img]

Since the map is smaller than the others, the boost bonus are easier to find, which make possible to collect many of them in the same time and use multiple boost bonus simultaneously.

    [*]Fixed achievement to unlock when clearing the adventure map from all cyborgs.

notes.title: Military Base arena map released for Cyborg Arena
notes.content:
With the goal of adding more content to the game and increasing its value and playing lifetime, [b]additional levels for the arena mode[/b] were planed and are now being [b]added to the game[/b].

For this update, a new arena map named [i]Military Base[/i] has been added in addition of the [b]2 arena maps already available in the game[/b].

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30573702/7bd8079eb6adab362ccb14b9d89b47e75c5a7876.jpg[/img]

This new map is consisting of the military camp which was already present in the adventure map.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30573702/3d078383cc565a94e43f5e8be31d5ef081a557bb.jpg[/img]

As the other arena maps, you will need to resist for as long as possible against waves of cyborgs using the boost bonus randomly spawning on the map and which will give you extra power and abilities.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30573702/d3c6a65c06ac29954c90b9a76f35783a96666f2a.jpg[/img]

The camp is surrounded by heavy fortifications made with large blocks of sandbags and barbed wires.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30573702/7ff3391601839de6af5b6d20cf16e81c1012df52.jpg[/img]

With destructible tents inside and by using grenades, most of the camp can be destroyed. This will become handy to easily find the spawning boost bonus and to create a clear view to spot incoming cyborgs. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30573702/168b85d53d9406bad347c1e6e4ad35a73a969150.jpg[/img]

Along this new map, some minor improvements were added such as the ability to crush cyborgs with the buggy, along a couple of bugs fixes.

Thanks for reading.

[i]Devdan[/i]
http://devdangames.com

notes.title: Minor updates for Cyborg Arena
notes.content:
[i][b]Cyborg Arena[/b][/i] has just been released as an Early Access on Steam this last week-end, with the adventure map followed by 2 arena maps. The 2 other arena maps are still in development but should come soon.

The adventure map is complete and features a story line where the player will discover the plot by listening to conversations between soldiers and commanders through the radios placed on the map. Voice acting has been done with subtitles to enhance the atmosphere.

[img]http://media.indiedb.com/cache/images/groups/1/4/3338/thumb_620x2000/1.15.jpg[/img]

[img]http://media.indiedb.com/cache/images/groups/1/4/3338/thumb_620x2000/2.14.jpg[/img]

[img]http://media.indiedb.com/cache/images/groups/1/4/3338/thumb_620x2000/3.11.jpg[/img]

The game has also already received some updates since its release to improve it and fix some issues which appeared lately. Here is a list of the small tweaks and fixes which have been done :
[list][*]Fixed the cyborg boss sometimes not spawning in the small scrapyard of the adventure map[/*][*]Auto-shotgun is now more accurate[/*][*]Fixed lags in the arena mode[/*][*]Fixed the player collision mesh when crouching[/*][*]Fixed cyborgs who could not hit the player[/*][*]Added more cyborgs in the military base[/*][*]Fixed firing impacts effects of the cyborgs.[/*][*]Medkits will now extend boost time in arena mode[/*][*]Re-adjusted cyborgs accuracy for easy and medium difficulty[/*][*]Added a congratulation screen when completing the adventure map[/*][/list]
Achievements were also added, with a total of 17 achievements to unlock. You can find the full list here : [url=http://steamcommunity.com/stats/706440/achievements]http://steamcommunity.com/stats/706440/achievements[/url]

[img]http://media.indiedb.com/cache/images/groups/1/4/3338/thumb_620x2000/5.6.jpg[/img]

[img]http://media.indiedb.com/cache/images/groups/1/4/3338/thumb_620x2000/6.6.jpg[/img]

[img]http://media.indiedb.com/cache/images/groups/1/4/3338/thumb_620x2000/7.6.jpg[/img]

[img]http://media.indiedb.com/cache/images/groups/1/4/3338/thumb_620x2000/8.4.jpg[/img]

More improvements and updates will of course come in the future. The next update should see the third arena map added to the game, which should be [i]Scrapyard Night[/i] or [i]Military Base[/i].

Thanks for reading.
[url=http://devdangames.com][u]Devdan[/u][/url]

notes.title: Cyborg Arena available soon in Early Access !
notes.content:
After the game has left Greenlight to be announced as a [i]Coming Soon[/i], the development has been progressing well and with a lot of internal testing, [i][b]Cyborg Arena[/b][/i] will be available as an Early Access for this next week !

With a good news, it will come with more features than what was planned. To sum it up, the game will contains [b]one large adventure map[/b] with [b]4 instant battle maps[/b] featuring the [b]arena mode[/b] !

Here are some screenshots of the maps :
[img]http://media.indiedb.com/cache/images/groups/1/4/3338/thumb_620x2000/rise_of_the_cyborgs.jpg[/img]
[i]Rise of the Cyborgs (adventure)[/i]

[img]http://media.indiedb.com/cache/images/groups/1/4/3338/thumb_620x2000/scrapyard_day.jpg[/img]
[i]Scrapyard (arena)[/i]

[img]http://media.indiedb.com/cache/images/groups/1/4/3338/thumb_620x2000/military_base.jpg[/img]
[i]Military Base (arena)[/i]

[img]http://media.indiedb.com/cache/images/groups/1/4/3338/thumb_620x2000/scrapyard_night.jpg[/img]
[i]Scrapyard Night (arena)[/i]

[img]http://media.indiedb.com/cache/images/groups/1/4/3338/thumb_620x2000/gas_station.jpg[/img]
[i]Gas Station (arena)[/i]

The [b]adventure map[/b] will have [b]large explorable areas[/b], with many items and weapons to find, a [b]driveable buggy[/b] and a story line backed with [b]voice acting[/b] and [b]scripted sequences[/b].

It will be also a good way to familiarize with the game before jumping into the [b]arena mode[/b], where the gameplay will switch from a [b]survival shooter[/b] to a [b]fast paced action game[/b] !

With collectible [b]boost bonus[/b] to gain extra powers such as high speed, high jumps, unlimited ammo, explosive ammo, etc... [b]achieve the best score[/b] against the cyborgs !

More news to come soon next, with the launch of the game and adding of achievements, stay tuned.

Thanks for reading.
[url=http://devdangames.com][i]Devdan[/i][/url]

notes.title: Some news about Cyborg Arena since Greenlight !
notes.content:
[b]Following the game being Greenlit on May 2017, the development has been progressing well[/b] since then with many additional contents and features added to what was initially planned !

[img]http://devdangames.com/steam/cyborgarena_2017_10_09/1.jpg[/img]

The game will now consist of[b] a large adventure map[/b] where you will be able to [b]drive a buggy[/b] to explore large areas and collect dispersed items and weapons, with parallel tasks of [b]finding and eliminating the cyborgs and their commanders[/b].

[img]http://media.indiedb.com/cache/images/games/1/61/60261/thumb_620x2000/2.jpg[/img]

Along the adventure map,[b] battles maps[/b] will also be available and will be featuring an [b][u]arena mode[/u][/b] with [b]boost bonus[/b] spawning during the game which give [b]high jumps, invulnerability, unlimited ammo, high speed[/b], etc... to resist for as long as possible against waves of cyborgs.

[img]http://media.indiedb.com/cache/images/games/1/61/60261/thumb_620x2000/6.jpg[/img]

There are now also some new powerful weapons such as [b]automatic shotguns[/b], [b]laser rifles[/b] and [b]assault rifles[/b] which will be boostable with [b]explosive ammo[/b] crates dispersed on the maps !

[img]http://media.indiedb.com/cache/images/games/1/61/60261/thumb_620x2000/9.jpg[/img]

Of course, [b]achievements [/b]to unlock will also be available, along support of [b]Steam cloud[/b] and customisable graphics settings, including support for [b]4k resolution[/b] and the ability to play with [b]Xbox-like gamepads[/b].

[img]http://media.indiedb.com/cache/images/games/1/61/60261/thumb_620x2000/5.jpg[/img]

The [b]destruction system[/b] from [u][b]Action Alien[/b][/u] has also been brought the game and will be present in the adventure map and especially in the [u]Gas Station[/u] map.

[img]http://media.indiedb.com/cache/images/games/1/61/60261/thumb_620x2000/3.jpg[/img]

Right now the game is set as [b]Coming Soon[/b], but it is planned to be released as an [b]Early Access[/b] in not longer than a month !

[img]http://media.indiedb.com/cache/images/games/1/61/60261/thumb_620x2000/7.jpg[/img]

[img]http://media.indiedb.com/cache/images/games/1/61/60261/thumb_620x2000/8.jpg[/img]

[img]http://media.indiedb.com/cache/images/games/1/61/60261/thumb_620x2000/4.2.jpg[/img]

[img]http://media.indiedb.com/cache/images/games/1/61/60261/thumb_620x2000/10.jpg[/img]

Don't forget also to watch out the new trailer !
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vFOZRgwSj3U
Thanks for reading.
[url=http://devdangames.com][i]Devdan[/i][/url] 
[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/706440]
